prep_list: SELECT c.start_date AS ship_date, CASE c.contract_sts WHEN '00' THEN '가계약' WHEN '10' THEN '출고가능' WHEN '20' THEN '출고확인' WHEN '30' THEN '출고준비완료' WHEN '70' THEN '출고완료' END AS status, cl.cus_name AS client, COALESCE(mo.model_name, mo2.model_name, '미지정') AS model, CASE WHEN c.contract_type='EXTENSION' THEN '연장' WHEN cd.is_used='Y' THEN '중고' ELSE '신차' END AS kind, COALESCE(cd.plate_number,'') AS plate, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sm.div_value SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_contract_material cm JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx AND sm.div_code='01'),'') AS box, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sm.div_value SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_contract_material cm JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx AND sm.div_code='07'),'') AS crossbar, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sm.div_value SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_contract_material cm JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx AND sm.div_code IN ('02','04','05','06')),'') AS etc_parts, cd.idx AS detail_id FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx JOIN tb_client cl ON cl.idx=c.cus_idx LEFT JOIN tb_chassis ch ON ch.idx=cd.chassis_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t ON t.trim_code=ch.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo ON mo.model_code=t.model_code LEFT JOIN tb_price pr ON pr.idx=cd.product_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t2 ON t2.trim_code=pr.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo2 ON mo2.model_code=t2.model_code WHERE c.start_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d') AND c.contract_sts IN ('00','10','20','30','70') AND c.contract_type NOT IN ('TRANSFER','TRANSFERED') ORDER BY c.start_date, model LIMIT 200
prep_parts: SELECT COALESCE(cc.code_name,'기타') AS gubun, sm.div_value AS item, SUM(cm.quantity) AS qty FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx JOIN tb_contract_material cm ON cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx LEFT JOIN tb_code cc ON cc.group_code='SUB_MATERIAL_CODE' AND cc.code_value=sm.div_code WHERE c.start_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d') AND c.contract_sts IN ('00','10','20','30') AND c.contract_type NOT IN ('TRANSFER','TRANSFERED') AND sm.div_code IN ('01','02','04','05','06','07') GROUP BY gubun, sm.div_code, sm.div_value ORDER BY sm.div_code, qty DESC LIMIT 200
relist: SELECT p.post_no, CASE p.status WHEN 'AVAILABLE' THEN '재리스 대기' WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '출고 예정' END AS status, p.trim_name, p.plate_number AS plate, p.mileage, p.delivery_box_label AS box, p.key_info, p.maintenance_history AS maintenance, p.exterior_condition AS exterior, p.start_date AS ship_date FROM tb_lease_remain_post p WHERE p.status IN ('AVAILABLE','PENDING') ORDER BY p.status, p.in_dtm DESC LIMIT 200
materials: SELECT COALESCE(cc.code_name,'기타') AS gubun, sm.div_value AS item, sm.inventory AS cms_stock, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.quantity),0) FROM tb_contract_material cm JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.idx=cm.contract_detail_idx JOIN tb_contract c ON c.idx=cd.contract_idx WHERE cm.material_idx=sm.idx AND c.contract_sts='70' AND c.start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d')) AS used30 FROM tb_sub_material sm LEFT JOIN tb_code cc ON cc.group_code='SUB_MATERIAL_CODE' AND cc.code_value=sm.div_code WHERE sm.use_yn='Y' AND sm.div_code IN ('01','03','04','05','06','07') ORDER BY sm.div_code, used30 DESC LIMIT 200
trend: SELECT r.ym AS month, r.total_cnt, COALESCE(m.box_qty,0) AS box_qty, COALESCE(m.crossbar_qty,0) AS crossbar_qty FROM (SELECT LEFT(c.start_date,7) ym, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.idx) total_cnt FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx WHERE c.contract_sts='70' AND c.contract_type='NEW' AND cd.is_used='N' AND c.start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY ym) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT(c.start_date,7) ym, SUM(CASE WHEN sm.div_code='01' THEN cm.quantity ELSE 0 END) box_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN sm.div_code='07' OR sm.div_value LIKE '크로스바%' THEN cm.quantity ELSE 0 END) crossbar_qty FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx JOIN tb_contract_material cm ON cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE c.contract_sts='70' AND c.contract_type='NEW' AND cd.is_used='N' AND c.start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY ym) m ON m.ym=r.ym ORDER BY r.ym
returns_unreg: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.in_dtm) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.up_dtm),'%Y-%m-%d') AS return_date, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.apply_date) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.contract_end_date) AS apply_date, cl.cus_name AS client, cd.plate_number AS plate, RIGHT(ch.chassis_number,6) AS chassis6, COALESCE(mo.model_name,'미지정') AS model, p.mileage, i.insu_end_date AS insu_end, CASE WHEN p.status='AVAILABLE' THEN '재리스 대기' WHEN p.status='PENDING' THEN '출고 예정' WHEN p.status='COMPLETED' THEN '재출고 완료' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_contract_detail cd2 JOIN tb_contract c2 ON c2.idx=cd2.contract_idx WHERE cd2.chassis_idx=cd.chassis_idx AND cd2.idx>cd.idx AND c2.contract_sts NOT IN ('90','91','92')) THEN '재출고 완료' ELSE '미등록' END AS relist_status, cd.idx AS detail_id FROM tb_contract_detail cd JOIN tb_contract c ON c.idx=cd.contract_idx JOIN tb_client cl ON cl.idx=c.cus_idx JOIN tb_price pr ON pr.idx=cd.product_idx LEFT JOIN tb_chassis ch ON ch.idx=cd.chassis_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t ON t.trim_code=ch.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo ON mo.model_code=t.model_code LEFT JOIN tb_insurance i ON i.idx=cd.insurance_idx LEFT JOIN tb_lease_remain_post p ON p.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx WHERE cd.status='EXPIRE' AND pr.product_div='02' AND c.contract_type<>'EXTENSION' AND COALESCE(cd.is_extended,'')<>'Y' AND p.idx IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_contract_detail cd2 JOIN tb_contract c2 ON c2.idx=cd2.contract_idx WHERE cd2.chassis_idx=cd.chassis_idx AND cd2.idx>cd.idx AND c2.contract_sts NOT IN ('90','91','92')) ORDER BY return_date LIMIT 200
returns: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.in_dtm) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.up_dtm),'%Y-%m-%d') AS return_date, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.apply_date) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.contract_end_date) AS apply_date, cl.cus_name AS client, cd.plate_number AS plate, RIGHT(ch.chassis_number,6) AS chassis6, COALESCE(mo.model_name,'미지정') AS model, p.mileage, i.insu_end_date AS insu_end, CASE WHEN p.status='AVAILABLE' THEN '재리스 대기' WHEN p.status='PENDING' THEN '출고 예정' WHEN p.status='COMPLETED' THEN '재출고 완료' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_contract_detail cd2 JOIN tb_contract c2 ON c2.idx=cd2.contract_idx WHERE cd2.chassis_idx=cd.chassis_idx AND cd2.idx>cd.idx AND c2.contract_sts NOT IN ('90','91','92')) THEN '재출고 완료' ELSE '미등록' END AS relist_status, cd.idx AS detail_id FROM tb_contract_detail cd JOIN tb_contract c ON c.idx=cd.contract_idx JOIN tb_client cl ON cl.idx=c.cus_idx JOIN tb_price pr ON pr.idx=cd.product_idx LEFT JOIN tb_chassis ch ON ch.idx=cd.chassis_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t ON t.trim_code=ch.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo ON mo.model_code=t.model_code LEFT JOIN tb_insurance i ON i.idx=cd.insurance_idx LEFT JOIN tb_lease_remain_post p ON p.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx WHERE cd.status='EXPIRE' AND pr.product_div='02' AND c.contract_type<>'EXTENSION' AND COALESCE(cd.is_extended,'')<>'Y' AND p.status IN ('AVAILABLE','PENDING') ORDER BY return_date DESC LIMIT 200
ret_summary: SELECT CASE WHEN p.status='AVAILABLE' THEN '재리스 대기' WHEN p.status='PENDING' THEN '출고 예정' WHEN p.status='COMPLETED' THEN '재출고 완료' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_contract_detail cd2 JOIN tb_contract c2 ON c2.idx=cd2.contract_idx WHERE cd2.chassis_idx=cd.chassis_idx AND cd2.idx>cd.idx AND c2.contract_sts NOT IN ('90','91','92')) THEN '재출고 완료' ELSE '미등록' END AS relist_status, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.idx) AS cnt FROM tb_contract_detail cd JOIN tb_contract c ON c.idx=cd.contract_idx JOIN tb_client cl ON cl.idx=c.cus_idx JOIN tb_price pr ON pr.idx=cd.product_idx LEFT JOIN tb_chassis ch ON ch.idx=cd.chassis_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t ON t.trim_code=ch.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo ON mo.model_code=t.model_code LEFT JOIN tb_insurance i ON i.idx=cd.insurance_idx LEFT JOIN tb_lease_remain_post p ON p.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx WHERE cd.status='EXPIRE' AND pr.product_div='02' AND c.contract_type<>'EXTENSION' AND COALESCE(cd.is_extended,'')<>'Y' AND COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.in_dtm) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.up_dtm) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY relist_status
ret_model: SELECT COALESCE(mo.model_name,'미지정') AS model, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.idx) AS cnt FROM tb_contract_detail cd JOIN tb_contract c ON c.idx=cd.contract_idx JOIN tb_client cl ON cl.idx=c.cus_idx JOIN tb_price pr ON pr.idx=cd.product_idx LEFT JOIN tb_chassis ch ON ch.idx=cd.chassis_idx LEFT JOIN tb_trim t ON t.trim_code=ch.trim_code LEFT JOIN tb_model mo ON mo.model_code=t.model_code LEFT JOIN tb_insurance i ON i.idx=cd.insurance_idx LEFT JOIN tb_lease_remain_post p ON p.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx WHERE cd.status='EXPIRE' AND pr.product_div='02' AND c.contract_type<>'EXTENSION' AND COALESCE(cd.is_extended,'')<>'Y' AND COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.in_dtm) FROM tb_contract_cancel_snapshot s WHERE s.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx), cd.up_dtm) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 200
boxes_m: SELECT LEFT(c.start_date,7) AS month, sm.div_value AS item, SUM(cm.quantity) AS qty FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx JOIN tb_contract_material cm ON cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE c.contract_sts='70' AND c.contract_type='NEW' AND cd.is_used='N' AND c.start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') AND sm.div_code='01' GROUP BY month, sm.div_value ORDER BY month, qty DESC LIMIT 200
crossbars_m: SELECT LEFT(c.start_date,7) AS month, sm.div_value AS item, SUM(cm.quantity) AS qty FROM tb_contract c JOIN tb_contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_idx=c.idx JOIN tb_contract_material cm ON cm.contract_detail_idx=cd.idx JOIN tb_sub_material sm ON sm.idx=cm.material_idx WHERE c.contract_sts='70' AND c.contract_type='NEW' AND cd.is_used='N' AND c.start_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') AND (sm.div_code='07' OR sm.div_value LIKE '크로스바%') GROUP BY month, sm.div_value ORDER BY month, qty DESC LIMIT 200
